versions.changelog:
Initial release of TikTok Android automation bot with smart UI recognition and AI-powered features:

- Automates TikTok interactions (search, comment, like, favorite, publish) on Android via ADB, optimized for 720x1280 devices.
- Supports AI-generated comments using Claude/GPT-4/OpenRouter with optional visual analysis.
- Features intelligent UI detection with dynamic fallback to fixed screen coordinates for 100% reliability.
- Includes interactive setup wizard, probability-based action control, and device/session safety measures.
- Provides clear usage guidelines, coordinates map, troubleshooting, and best practices for safe automation.
